change.eligibility: Already decoded uncompressed S8 SW_64KB_Z_X eight-sample single-mip/slice surfaces with equal coverage/fragments, canonical pitch, zero pipe/bank XOR, exact 64-KiB alignment/equation and bounded storage/index/descriptor/workgroup limits. D16S8 and D32S8 metadata are admitted; native image-chain proof below uses only D32S8.
change.cpuFallback: Unset,0,yes do not create the per-device helper. Unsupported metadata retains the existing CPU Detile/Tile path and graphics validation.
change.programOwnership: One per-device helper owns two immutable compute programs, detile and retile. No guest address, bytes, resident image content or draw resources are cached.
change.wordOwnership: Each XY/group invocation owns four contiguous S8 bytes. Two groups cover all eight samples. The independent AMD coordinate oracle verifies aligned contiguous samples and unique addresses, preventing shared-word races.
change.transferOwnership: Every Record owns a distinct descriptor pool/set retained until Transfer destruction; buffers/owner remain live through the existing synchronous fence. Per-device teardown releases programs/modules/layouts before VkDevice destruction.
barriers: Seeded host buffer to detile compute read
Detile compute write to fragment stencil-upload read
Fragment upload read to stencil-readback overwrite
Stencil-readback compute write to retile compute read
Prior compute source read and seeded host write to retile output write
Retile compute write to host read before the existing fence
change.writeback: The complete original tiled seed initializes the GPU output. Retile changes only logical S8 words. After existing SubmitAndWait, resource fault checks and resources.WriteBack, existing GuestMemory::WriteChanged commits only byte runs differing from the original seed. Unchanged logical/padding bytes preserve later ordered CPU/alias stores.
preservedGuards: Grouped draw no observed Z test/write/bounds or consumed HTILE
Guest-memory full-range snapshot and shader-input attachment alias rejection
Existing sample locations, masks, stencil ops and fault checks
Unchanged image quality/sample count and synchronous completion
change.memoryBoundary: An extra tiled GPU buffer is retained during the wait alongside the existing seed/packed buffer. It replaces the later legacy CPU tiled temporary. This capacity calculation is not measured RSS, jetsam or device memory qualification.

coverage: Distinct sets retained across repeated recording calls
Zero-command rejection on invalid calls/missing dispatch
productionContract.shaderValidation: Original GLSL compiles to byte-matching embedded SPIR-V and passes spirv-val for Vulkan1.1.
productionContract.boundary: Production helper/layout code with counted Vulkan mocks, not actual Draw or command-buffer GPU execution.

nativeGpu.falsePassControls: Separate independent AMD coordinate/byte oracles for detile and changed-byte retile. Poisoned source/packed intermediates and separately seeded padding prevent omitted transfers or mutually cancelling layout errors from passing. Guard regions surround aligned nonzero storage offsets.
nativeGpu.boundary: Actual production tiler and StencilSampleTransfer on a real Mac GPU with an original synthetic D32S8 owner and depth reader. No actual Draw/DepthSurface/GuestMemory integration, Wine/FEX or iPad execution is established.

existingGuestWritebackReference.scope: The unchanged existing WriteChanged regression previously exercises shared mapped aliases, padding/unchanged logical CPU bytes, driver-generation invalidation and no-op behavior using simulated GPU output. It is not a new S8 GPU-to-Windows integrated result.

independentReadOnlyReview.hashesVerified: Eight frozen production paths/baselines, patch, native included-source/artifact hashes, four public workflow hashes and completed contract log.
independentReadOnlyReview.productionFlowReviewed: Current snapshot/seed admission, grouped no-Z and alias checks, exact upload/readback/retile barriers, per-call descriptor/fence ownership and changed-byte commit after existing fault checks.

qualification.fullHleBuildStateAtPublication: In progress; terminal build/runtime checks will be recorded separately.

limits: The full HLE build and runtime suites are pending/separate, not inferred from focused native checks.
D16S8 passes helper metadata admission only; all six native stencil image chains use D32S8.
The unchanged Z result is the initialized 0.625 value within 1e-6 tolerance, not arbitrary-depth or bitwise preservation proof.
The helper does not add asynchronous resident targets, stencil transfer pipeline caching, HTILE/depth consumption or unsupported formats/sample counts.
Ordered unchanged-byte CPU/alias preservation is retained through WriteChanged; racing CPU writes to GPU-changed logical bytes and inherited concurrent own-store attribution remain unqualified.
Native GPU buffers and mock descriptor lifetimes do not qualify iPad memory pressure, repeated teardown, visual correctness or speed.
An existing excluded BDA test-target companion link gap predates this patch; no BDA target acceptance is claimed.
No device gameplay, sustained FPS, measured speed gain, sound/save/lifecycle or release acceptance follows from this record.
